expected_issues.title: Node.__hash__ hashes unhashable list fields
expected_issues.description:
Node.__hash__ now hashes the node fields, which include lists (e.g. Output.nodes, Call.args), so hashing almost any template node raises TypeError: unhashable type: 'list'.

The previous implementation explicitly kept identity hashing (object.__hash__) while defining field-based __eq__. Replacing it with hash(tuple(iter_fields())) breaks every caller that puts nodes in sets or dict keys (third-party extensions such as django-compressor), and would also make hashes of mutable nodes change over time. Keep `__hash__ = object.__hash__`.
